confidence.limits: Confidence is moderate for source meaning, caller fit, and clear terminology/grammar issues. Idiomatic quality in Hindi, Arabic, Vietnamese, and Indonesian is lower confidence. No native-speaker signoff was obtained.

processExposure.statement: This review used the candidate-free README, manifest, verifier, checksum inventory, selected English source cells, current target cells, and caller contexts only. It did not inspect the primary-review directory, repository/worktree, PR body, earlier windows' review decisions, or external sources/search. The checksum pass read candidate-free package files at byte level, including opaque prior-evidence reattestation files, but those files were not parsed or used as review decisions. No browser review was performed and no native-speaker signoff is claimed.
